descriptions.normal: A snack fried in oil. Shaped flour is lowered directly into the pot to be deep-fried until golden-brown before being fished out and dipped into syrup while piping hot. This treat is an inseparable companion to many in Sumeru.
descriptions.suspicious: A snack fried in oil. The fruit-shaped pieces of batter were not rescued from the oil-filled pot in time, and when you bite into it, your mouth practically overflows with grease, a predicament from which only a speedy chug of coffee can save you.
descriptions.delicious: A snack fried in oil. The radiant, golden fruit-shaped pieces wrapped up in tasty syrup are gone ever so quickly, one bite and one piece at a time. Hmm, there's still one thread of honey on the plate. Perhaps this sweetness can yet be made to last one second more...

effectTexts.normal: Decreases all party members' gliding and sprinting Stamina consumption by 20% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
effectTexts.suspicious: Decreases all party members' gliding and sprinting Stamina consumption by 15% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
effectTexts.delicious: Decreases all party members' gliding and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
